title: M2 - reproduce the published cost and speed advantage of batching
doc_ref: docs.typesafe.ai/primitives - 'batching 13 questions into one call is 11.5x cheaper and 9.6x faster'
note: The docs put a precise number on batching: thirteen questions in one request against thirteen separate requests, 11.5x cheaper and 9.6x faster, with no change in the answers. Both arms run serially here so the speed ratio is a fair wall-clock comparison. The answer-identity half doubles as the strongest test of the independence claim: if a question's answer shifts when twelve unrelated questions sit beside it, they are not evaluated in isolation. Generated by scripts/gen_large_cases.py.
